rules: BattleMapBase.GotoNextScreen default argument is 0.2; calls Camera2.gotoNextScreen before incrementing LevelParam.nowScreen.
Camera2.doInAdvance centers living players, clamps to current ScreenRange, then lerps old view translation by _moveSpeed.
Camera2._goingNext/_lasetX preserves the old viewport start and ratchets the desired left edge until reaching the new region minimum.
The normal transition does not restore _moveSpeed to 1.
Camera2.advanceTime returns when all follow targets are dead.
implementation: preauthored FollowTarget -> native PhantomCamera2D GLUED -> scoped native PhantomCameraHost MANUAL -> Camera2D
timing: alpha = 1 - pow(1 - source_weight, source_fps * combat_delta); exact for constant targets, samples moving targets at Godot physics ticks
